faq.subtitle: Questions
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers to the most commonly asked questions

questions.question: How much does it cost?
questions.answer: Creating an account on the Check It Out platform is completely free for both brands and influencers. Currently, collaboration announcements are free of charge, but starting in 2026, we will charge companies a fee of 80 PLN (net) per listing.

questions.question: How can I register?
questions.answer: Registration on the Check It Out platform is simple. Just click the "Sign up" button in the top right corner of the page, choose the account type (business or influencer), and then fill out the registration form. After data verification, you can use all the platform's features.

questions.question: How do influencers settle payments with companies?
questions.answer: Payments are made according to the terms outlined in the specific listing. Check It Out does not mediate payments; however, our platform monitors whether both parties have fulfilled the previously agreed terms. In the event of reported fraud, the affected party can rely on full support from the Check It Out team.

questions.question: How does the collaboration system work? As an influencer, do I have access to all offers?
questions.answer: As an influencer, you have access to all offers for which your account meets the requirements (e.g., location, number of followers).

questions.question: Does submitting an application for collaboration automatically mean its acceptance?
questions.answer: No, your application must be accepted by the company that posted it. The company has the option to review your profile, statistics, and previous collaborations, and then decides whether to accept your application. After the company accepts your application, you must also confirm the terms of the collaboration.
